issue.body:
# 🐞 bug report ### Affected Package The issue is caused by package @angular/core ### Is this a regression? Not sure ### Description Using ::ng-deep` causes the styles to be applied to elements completely outside of the component's template. According to the documentation it should only affect elements inside the child's template and descendant component's templates. ## 🔬 Minimal Reproduction https://stackblitz.com/edit/angular-oo7twb?file=src%2Fapp%2Fhello.component.ts ## 🔥 Exception or Error Notice that all 3 `

` elements are styled with the `::after` text. The first one should not get the style. ## 🌍 Your Environment Angular 7.2.13

body: We may want to document the pattern of using `:host ::ng-deep` to achieve the effect of applying the styles only to the descendants tree.
